storyCards.fact:
Tyga's "Rack City" reached #7 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #7 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 25 weeks on the chart.

Rack City was released in 2012.

Album: Careless World: Rise Of The Last King (2012).
